servinfo.title: Front Door Lock Assembly Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove door trim and sealing cover.

attention3.ptxt: Perform this work with front window fully closed.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect harness clamp (1) from front door rear sash.
Remove front door rear sash bolts (3) and remove front door rear sash (4).
Remove lock (1) in arrow direction “1” and then move door lock open rod (2) in arrow direction “2” to remove it from outside door handle (3).
Disconnect front door lock connector (4) from front door lock assembly (5).
Remove inside door handle (7) by moving it in arrow directions “3” and “4”.
Remove inside door handle and front door lock assembly as a unit.
Remove inside door handle cable clip (8).
Remove door lock wires (1) from inside door handle (2) by pulling them in arrow direction.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Apply grease to sliding parts and rotation parts of door lock assembly.
Tighten each screw to specified torque referring to Front Door Lock Components .
Move door latch striker (2) up or down to align its center with the center of groove (3) on front door lock assembly (1) as shown in figure.
Move door latch striker (1) to adjust front door panel surface (2) flat with rear door panel surface (3) as shown in figure.
